_evidence: Menu option bytes of the 0x52bae5 group (0x52bb48/0x52bbae/0x52bc14/0x52bc7a). Each walker reads its setting 'mov al,[0x81d60f|0x81d610|0x81d611|0x81d612]' (any byte: it only indexes the 256-byte table 0x81dc63 via 0x52bd00's 'movzx eax,al', so all values are valid) and the first three compare it with their last-seen copy 'cmp al,[0x81d634|0x81d635|0x81d636]; je' (alias: equal in about half the cases, so both the skip and the copy-and-call path run). The changed flags 0x81d617/0x81d61c/0x81d61e are written 1/0 by the code; 0x81d61c and 0x81d61e are also read back ('cmp byte [..],0; jne') when the second 0x52bd00 call returns CF=1 and leaves them unwritten, so their entry values mix zero and nonzero (0x81d617 is only written; the mix shows whether a store happened).
